hero.title: Get our EU PPWR essentials pack
intro: The EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation has applied since 12 August 2026. Every pack you place on the EU market now needs evidence and a signed Declaration of Conformity.
Our essentials pack gives you the slides and answers from our PPWR webinar with Veolia, so you can see what applies to you and what to do first.
